description: This file contains the implementation of a guardrail class named ToolPermissionGuardrail for managing tool usage permissions within a language model API. It defines logic for matching rules, checking tool permissions pre- and post-model invocation, modifying requests/responses to enforce rules, and handling permission errors. The class is part of a larger system integrating with FastAPI, custom guardrail logic, and various utility modules.

classes.name: ToolPermissionGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class that enforces tool usage permissions based on configurable rules, supporting pre-call and post-call hooks, argument validation, response modification, and error handling.
